---
title: "Signing up for free GitHub and molab accounts"
---

For learning core concepts of computational biology, we will be using
[marimo python notebooks](https://marimo.io/)
via marimo's
[molab service](https://molab.marimo.io).
To access these notebooks, you will need to sign up for a free account on
GitHub and molab.

## Signing up for a free GitHub account

If you already have a GitHub account, you are welcome to use it for our class
and can skip this section.

Please go to
[GitHub's website](https://github.com/)
and click "Sign up" in the upper right of the screen (@fig-gh-signup).

![GitHub sign up.](
    images/gh-sign-up.png
){
    #fig-gh-signup
    fig-align="center"
    fig-alt="GitHub sign up"
}

Create a username and enter your information.
***I recommend creating a username you will want to continue using for many
years***.
Also, please feel free to use a personal email address for your GitHub account
(*i.e.*, you are not required to use your AU account).

## Signing up for a free molab account

If you already have a molab account, you are welcome to use it for out class
and can skip this section.

1.  Please go to
    [marimo's molab website](https://molab.marimo.io)

2.  Click the "Sign in" button near the top right of the screen, and in the
    "Create your account" window that pops up, click "GitHub" (@fig-ml-acct).

    ![Create molab account.](
        images/molab-create-acct.png
    ){
        #fig-ml-acct
        fig-align="center"
        fig-alt="Create molab account"
    }

3.  A "Sign in to GitHub to continue to marimo" window should pop open.
    Enter the username/email and password for your GitHub account
    and click "Sign in" (@fig-ml-gh-signin).

    ![Sign in using your GitHub credentials.](
        images/molab-gh-sign-in.png
    ){
        #fig-ml-gh-signin
        fig-align="center"
        fig-alt="Sign in using your GitHub credentials"
    }

4.  An "Authorize marimo" window should pop up. Click "Authorize marimo-team" (@fig-ml-auth).

    ![Authorize marimo to access info from GitHub.](
        images/molab-gh-authorize.png
    ){
        #fig-ml-auth
        fig-align="center"
        fig-alt="Click to authorize marimo to access info from GitHub"
    }

5.  You should now be logged in to your new molab account (@fig-ml-success)!

    ![Succesfully logged in to molab.](
        images/molab-success.png
    ){
        #fig-ml-success
        fig-align="center"
        fig-alt="Successfully logged in to molab"
    }

## molab account info

While logged in to your
[marimo molab](https://molab.marimo.io) account,
click on the icon near the upper right corner of the browser window, and, from
the drop-down, click "Manage account" (@fig-ml-acct-info).
This should open a "Profile details" window.

![Accessing molab account details.](
    images/molab-acct-info.png
){
    #fig-ml-acct-info
    fig-align="center"
    fig-alt="Accessing molab account details"
}

Please open the Exercise 3 quiz on Canvas and use the information in your molab
"Profile details" window to answer the questions below.

### Question 1

What is the primary email address listed in your molab profile details?


### Question 2

You should see your GitHub account listed for "Connected accounts."
Please enter your GitHub username that is displayed.
